newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Skanska says in group to reopen Finn hotel.
newsitem.headline: Skanska says in group to reopen Finn hotel.

text.p: Swedish construction company Skanska said on Thursday it was part of a consortium to renovate and expand the old Kamp Hotel in Helsinki, Finland.
The consortium includes Skanska's Finnish subsidiary Skanska Oy with 70 percent and the Finnish construction company Leo Heinanen with 30 percent.
The customer is the Finnish real estate company Merita Real Estate Ltd which is investing $50 million in the project.
The Kamp Hotel, built in 1887, has been used as a bank office since 1965. The new hotel with 180 rooms will be reopened under management by Sheraton.
Construction is scheduled for completion by the spring of 1999.
